text_a: No person shall discharge industrial effluent into waters of the state without a permit issued by the Department of Environmental Quality. Permits shall specify discharge limits and monitoring requirements.
text_b: Solid waste disposal facilities shall comply with closure and post-closure care requirements for a minimum period of 5 years following cessation of operations.
